newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Pensioner buys first ticket to Lisbon 1998 Expo.
newsitem.headline: Pensioner buys first ticket to Lisbon 1998 Expo.

text.p: A retired engineer from northern Portugal was first in line to buy a ticket for the Lisbon 1998 Expo on Thursday, exactly a year before the launch of the world fair.
"I'm very cautious and I don't want a repeat of what happened at the 1992 Seville Expo where tickets quickly sold out," said Fortunato Ventura de Almeida Santos.
The Lisbon Expo, which takes the oceans as its theme and runs from May 22 until September 30 1998, is expected to attract 15 million visitors from around the world.
A one-day ticket costs 5,000 escudos ($29) and a three-month pass costs 40,000 escudos ($235).
